text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, while I'm out on a leisurely
stroll...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
G-good morning, Cafe! Are you also
going to
train?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Curious. So you wish to conquer the
rising sun?!
Hats off to you! Who knew
you had the makings
of a lead actress?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... don't know what you're talking
about... but I
think... I wouldn't compare
myself... to you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! It goes without saying! Both
you and
Doto are brilliant and
undeniable catalysts to my
shine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it follows that you two would
be star
material yourselves! Bask in my
resplendence and
shine brilliantly!
Come, let us run together,

hand-in-hand, on this fine morning!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-um, Opera O? Cafe has already gone
off on
her own.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, she has the tendencies of a feline.
Turn
away for just a second and she's
vanished,
gracefully and nimbly.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Plus, she seems—how should I put this... She looks focused, like she's chasing something with all her heart.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-do you think that it could be the
rumored,
invisible Friend of hers?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! A feline's friend would be a
feline as
well! Even if one cannot see the
other, their
footsteps pitter-patter in
tandem!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, we shan't fall behind. Let us make
haste,
Doto! Over yonder, to where the
light shines!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: C-coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This early in the morning and they're
already
bursting with energy. I silently
offer my words of
encouragement and
watch as they disappear into
the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At night, as I finish up work and start to
head
home, I come across Manhattan
Cafe resting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I saw her with T.M. Opera
O and
Meisho Doto this morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They are... good friends... with each
other.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They push each other... to be better...
They're
different... from my Friend and
me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm always... on the receiving end... I
have...
nothing to give to my Friend... or
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't know a thing about
this
"friend" she always talks about. But
people with
clear goals become the
target many strive
toward. That alone
means she has something to
give.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
After... I passed you... my Friend was still
ahead...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I see... I gotta admit, that's a little
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One could say the frustration that girl
felt will
become a source of motivation.
And it would all
be thanks to Manhattan
Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I should head back... to the
track...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Just... a few more...
choice_data_list: Are you still going to run?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks tired. I should convince her to
get some
rest.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.
choice_data_list: Why not rest up early and run again in the morning?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Do you have... someone you want to...
catch up
to?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Must be nice... to have
someone... as your
equal... Someone who
inspires... and is inspired by
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showing a soft smile, Manhattan Cafe
disappears
into the dark of the night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will keep running... day or night... as
long as I
see my Friend... up ahead...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will catch up... then proudly tell her...
that I'm
her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a slight bow of the head,
Manhattan Cafe
returns to the track. I
hear her whisper "sorry for
the wait"
seemingly to no one.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... I'm not...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, I can see that her
legs look
slightly unsteady.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like that one time, someone might ask
to train
together with her. If she isn't fit
to run when that
happens...
choice_data_list: We need to make sure you're in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That isn't... a problem. I just want to...
catch up
to... my Friend...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Manhattan Cafe heads
back
towards the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes look longingly towards
something
invisible to my eyes.
